Although 1587''s list of the archbishops and bishops of London in the following paragraphs is more elaborate than that of 1577, and is placed in a different, and more logical position (1577''s comes near the end of Book III of the Description, in a sort of reference section), it seems reasonable to assume that the later version is based upon the former, and that the two are therefore rightly linked.
Appearances to the contrary, these two paragraphs match almost exactly, but a considerable portion of the 1577 one cannot be read by the Comparator.

Reign: 28 Elizabeth I (1585-6) A: The earl of Leicester in the Netherlands. The text published in 1587 after the censors had worked on it is considerably shorter than, and at some points radically different from, the original, as can be seen by comparing it with the latter as reinstated by Ellis, Vol. IV, pp. 630-60. The casualties included Thynne's treatise on the earls of Leicester, pp. 630-40; his accounts of the archbishops of Canterbury, the Lords Cobham, and the wardens of the Cinque Ports which followed were also excised, to be restored by Ellis as Vol. IV, pp. 660-844.
